import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.experimental import enable_iterative_imputer
from sklearn.impute import IterativeImputer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import BayesianRidge

def mice_imputation():
    # Create correlated dataset
    np.random.seed(42)
    n = 200
    x1 = np.random.randn(n)
    x2 = 2 * x1 + np.random.randn(n) * 0.5
    x3 = x1 + x2 + np.random.randn(n) * 0.3
    x4 = 0.5 * x2 - x3 + np.random.randn(n) * 0.4
    
    df = pd.DataFrame({'x1': x1, 'x2': x2, 'x3': x3, 'x4': x4})
    
    # Introduce missing values (15%)
    mask = np.random.random(df.shape) < 0.15
    df_missing = df.copy()
    df_missing.values[mask] = np.nan
    
    print(f"Total missing values: {df_missing.isnull().sum().sum()}")
    
    # MICE with BayesianRidge (default)
    imputer_br = IterativeImputer(
        estimator=BayesianRidge(),
        max_iter=10,
        random_state=42
    )
    df_imputed_br = pd.DataFrame(
        imputer_br.fit_transform(df_missing),
        columns=df.columns
    )
    
    # MICE with RandomForest
    imputer_rf = IterativeImputer(
        estimator=RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=10, random_state=42),
        max_iter=10,
        random_state=42
    )
    df_imputed_rf = pd.DataFrame(
        imputer_rf.fit_transform(df_missing),
        columns=df.columns
    )
    
    # Compare MSE
    from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
    mse_br = mean_squared_error(df.values[mask], df_imputed_br.values[mask])
    mse_rf = mean_squared_error(df.values[mask], df_imputed_rf.values[mask])
    
    print(f"\nMICE (BayesianRidge): MSE = {mse_br:.4f}")
    print(f"MICE (RandomForest):  MSE = {mse_rf:.4f}")
    
    print("\nOriginal correlations:")
    print(df.corr().round(2))
    print("\nImputed correlations (BayesianRidge):")
    print(df_imputed_br.corr().round(2))

mice_imputation()
